samples.summary: New cell-level unset path rebuilds cells with `compactCell`, which silently drops spill metadata (`spillRows`/`spillCols`/`spillAnchor`/`spillBlocked`) that the calculator/renderer depend on
samples.evidence: `removeCellStyleKeysInRange` writes `await this.store.set(anchor, compactCell(existing, next))` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:4366). `compactCell` only copies `v`, `f`, `s` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/style-mutation.ts:57-69), while `Cell` also carries `spillRows`, `spillCols`, `spillAnchor`, `spillBlocked` (packages/sheets/src/model/core/types.ts:209-217), which the array-formula code writes and reads: `sheet.setCell(ref, { v: anchorValue, f: cell.f, s: style, spillRows: rows, spillCols: cols })` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/calculator.ts:136) and `if (cell.spillRows && cell.spillCols && !cell.spillBlocked)` in the paint/expansion loops (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/calculator.ts:74, packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:1086). So decreasing decimals back to the inherited precision over a styled spill anchor erases its spill region metadata until the next recalculation. (Note: `setStyle` at sheet.ts:3682 already has this shape, so the invariant may already be violated elsewhere; the fix belongs in the new code — preserve the non-style fields, e.g. `{ ...existing, s: next }`-style compaction.)

samples.summary: `omitStyleKeys` can return an empty `{}` style, which is persisted as a column/row/sheet style layer and defeats the `!colStyle`/`!sheetStyle` fast-path checks other modules rely on (styles resolve to `{}` instead of `undefined`)
samples.evidence: Empty patches are dropped for `rangeStyles` (sheet.ts:4325-4329) but not for the layer maps: `this.colStyles.set(col, next); await this.store.setColumnStyle(col, next)` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:4295-4296) and the same for rows/sheet (4307-4308, 4284-4285) store `{}` when the layer only held the removed keys. Downstream, `resolveEffectiveStyle` short-circuits on `if (!s && !c && !r && !range && !cellStyle) return undefined;` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:883), the render hot path does the same (packages/sheets/src/view/gridcanvas.ts:1868-1877), and the workbook-level resolver too (packages/sheets/src/model/workbook/worksheet-grid.ts:117). A truthy `{}` makes all of these allocate a merged object for every cell of that column/row (or the whole sheet after an `all`-selection round trip) and makes `Sheet.getStyle` return `{}` where callers previously got `undefined` — the new test itself only asserts `style?.dp`/`style?.nf` rather than `toBeUndefined()` for the column case (packages/sheets/test/sheet/decimals.test.ts:193-195). YorkieStore persists the empty object into the CRDT (packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts:729, 787).

samples.summary: Dropping `dp` from `DefaultStyleValues` changes currency/percent formatting for consumers other than increase/decrease decimals: `dp: 2` is now persisted where it used to be pruned, and `formatValue` treats a stored `dp` differently from an absent one for currency
samples.evidence: `pruneRedundantDefaultStyleKeys` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/style-mutation.ts:258-295, driven by `DefaultStyleValues`) is used by `addRangeStylePatch`/`pruneShadowedRangeStylePatches` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:1861, 1883) for every `setRangeStyle` write, not just the decimal buttons. With `dp: 2` removed from the defaults, a `{nf:'currency', dp:2}` write now leaves `dp: 2` in the range patch, and `formatValue` explicitly branches on `dp === undefined` for currency to use the locale's own fraction digits (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/format.ts:135-146). In locales/currencies whose default is not 2 digits (JPY/KRW), a currency cell that previously fell back to locale digits after pruning now renders 2 decimals, and the increase-then-decrease round trip on a currency cell (not `inheritable` in `changeDecimals`, sheet.ts:4205) permanently leaves `dp: 2` residue.

samples.summary: `Decrease decimal places` at 0 decimals is now a complete no-op, changing long-standing toolbar behaviour (it used to apply `nf: 'number'`, adding thousands separators)
samples.evidence: Old `Spreadsheet.decreaseDecimals` clamped with `Math.max(0, dp - 1)` and always wrote `{dp: 0, nf: 'number'}`; the new path returns early on `target < 0` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:4198-4200) and the view just delegates (packages/sheets/src/view/spreadsheet.ts:546). Toolbar consumers (packages/frontend/src/components/formatting-toolbar.tsx:253, 834) therefore now produce no visible change for a plain integer cell — previously the click converted it to `nf:'number'` (e.g. `1234` → `1,234`). Nothing in the diff or the browser oracle covers this case; the oracle only exercises increase (packages/frontend/scripts/verify-hunt-oracles.mjs:632).

samples.summary: Task doc still describes a `Spreadsheet.applyDecimalDelta(delta)` that was never implemented; the shared logic landed as `Sheet.changeDecimals(delta)`
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260818-sheets-decimal-round-trip-todo.md:47-48 and its checklist line 65 claim both handlers were routed through a private `applyDecimalDelta` in `Spreadsheet`, but `packages/sheets/src/view/spreadsheet.ts:536,546` call `this.sheet.changeDecimals(±1)` and no `applyDecimalDelta` exists anywhere in the repo (grep for `applyDecimalDelta` returns only the doc).

finding.summary: New cell-level unset path rebuilds cells with `compactCell`, which silently drops spill metadata (`spillRows`/`spillCols`/`spillAnchor`/`spillBlocked`) that the calculator/renderer depend on

verdict.reason: Every element of the claim checks out in the repo. `removeCellStyleKeysInRange` writes `store.set(anchor, compactCell(existing, next))` (sheet.ts:4366-4370), and `compactCell` (style-mutation.ts:57-69) constructs a fresh object copying only `v`, `f`, `s`, discarding the `spillRows`/`spillCols`/`spillAnchor`/`spillBlocked` fields declared on `Cell` (types.ts:213-216). Those fields are written by the calculator on the spill anchor together with a style (`calculator.ts:136`, `calculator.ts:118-125`) and read by out-of-diff consumers to paint/expand the spill region (`calculator.ts:74-80`, `sheet.ts:1007-1023`, `sheet.ts:1086-1098`). `store.set` replaces rather than merges (yorkie-store.ts:259-272 with normalizeCell at 228-248), so the metadata is genuinely erased for all collaborators. The path is reachable from the UI: `changeDecimals` calls `unsetRangeStyleKeys` (sheet.ts:4208) which calls `removeCellStyleKeysInRange` (sheet.ts:4334); a spill anchor with an explicit `dp`/`nf` passes the `if (!existing?.s) continue` filter at sheet.ts:4358. No guard elsewhere prevents this. It is in-lane as a violated invariant other modules depend on, and major severity is appropriate.
